tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise}1. ch3:3.4Suppose $g_1$ and $g_2 = f g_1$ are conformally related metrics on an oriented $n$-manifold. Show that their volume forms are related by $d V_{g_2} = f^n d V_{g_1}$. \end{exercise}
